articles.name: title
articles.description: rowmenu2-0903 (DEFECT 2): `articles` is a system-managed table — title+wiki ARE the saved article's identity (renames go through `_renameArticleIdentity`, which migrates every dependent key across crawl_members/crawl_queue/links/crawls in one batch), and the rest (fetchedAt/extractBytes/seed/depth/depthCap/etc.) are written only by wikipick_net.dart's fetch/crawl/depth-change paths — never meant to be hand-edited. Depth specifically has its own controlled UI (the Cache-depth… long-press action, DEFECT 3, and the Topic screen's existing L1/L2 picker) that re-enqueues correctly; a raw text edit here would desync the article from its own crawl state. `readOnlyIf` renders every column inert/dimmed instead of a writable box — condition `title notEmpty`, true for any real saved row.

articles.name: wiki
articles.description: Language subdomain the page was fetched from, e.g. "en", "ko" — page identity is the pair (wiki, title), not title alone.

articles.name: revisionId
articles.description: Wikipedia revision id at time of fetch — shown in the reader footer for attribution.

articles.name: extractText

label.ja: キャッシュされたテキスト

articles.description: HTML-sourced markdown extract. W2 (0820): when saved with "Include images" on, a lead-image `![alt](local:<id>)` block is prepended ahead of the body, resolved via the articleImages table — text-only otherwise.

articles.name: fetchedAt
articles.description: Last time the content itself was downloaded. polish1-0818 fix: was `date` — the engine's own column coercion silently truncates a `date`-typed value to its calendar day (drops time-of-day) on every write, so a just-saved article's freshness badge computed its "ago" diff against MIDNIGHT, not the real save moment (looked like a UTC/timezone bug — it was column-type truncation).

articles.name: lastCheckedAt
articles.description: Last time currency was verified against the live revision id — may be newer than fetchedAt when a check found no change. Drives the staleness prompt (see app setting staleDays). polish1-0818 fix: was `date`, same truncation bug as fetchedAt.

articles.name: seed
articles.description: True if the user picked this directly, false if reached by crawling links.

label.es: Grados desde la semilla más cercana
label.fr: Degrés depuis la graine la plus proche
label.ja: 最寄りのシードからの次数
label.vi: Bậc từ hạt giống gần nhất

articles.name: extractBytes

label.ja: キャッシュサイズ（バイト）

articles.description: utf-8 byte length of extractText at fetch time — drives the Library size stat and the aggregate 20 MB / 200-article storage cap (Unit D); never recomputed from extractText at read time so the cap check stays O(rows), not O(bytes).

articles.name: sizeLabel
articles.description: v3a (W1): human-readable rendering of extractBytes (e.g. "44.2 KB") computed once at fetch/save time — drives the Library/home size attribute chip; tags render text columns verbatim, so this stays a plain formatted string rather than requiring a chart-style number formatter in ui.json.

articles.name: formatVersion

label.ja: フォーマットバージョン

articles.description: 1 = old explaintext/wiki-markers pipeline (pre wikipick-reader2-0817). 2 = HTML-sourced markdown with real headings, bold/italic, and tappable wikilinks. A row missing this column (pre-migration) is treated as 1. The reader shows an "update formatting?" banner on any row below 2.

articles.name: seedLayersCached
articles.description: v3a (W1): for a SEED row only — the max crawl_members depth actually reached by this seed's crawl so far (recomputed after every wikiFetchLayer run, partial runs included). 0/absent on a non-seed row (its own `depth` column is its layer attribute instead) and on a seed whose crawl has not fetched anything yet.

articles.name: imageBytes
articles.description: W2 (0820): raw bytes of this article's lead image (0 if none/off) — mirrors the matching articleImages row's bytes column. Counted toward the separate ~8 MB images sub-cap, never the 20 MB text cap (extractBytes stays text-only).

articles.name: totalBytes

label.ja: キャッシュ合計サイズ（バイト）

articles.description: W2 (0820): extractBytes + imageBytes, kept in sync at write time — the HONEST total for this article's Library footprint. The Library/home cache-size stat reads this column so images are never under-reported.

articles.name: depthCap
articles.description: wikipick-0820perf cosmetic fix: for a SEED row only — the per-save "Cache depth" option this article was actually saved with (mirrors its own crawls.depthCap at save time), so the reader's "Cache linked pages" button can say the true configured depth (1 or 2) instead of a hardcoded "1 layer" regardless of what the user picked. 0/absent on a non-seed row.

articles.name: description
articles.description: wikiparity-0820wp2: MediaWiki's one-line short description (Wikidata/pageprops `description`), fetched best-effort at save time — the italic subtitle Wikipedia's own app shows under a title, and the Library card snippet. Empty when the API had none; never fabricated.

articles.name: thumbnailUrl
articles.description: wikiparity-0820wp2: pageimages thumbnail URL (upload.wikimedia.org), fetched best-effort alongside `description` — a leading card thumbnail. Rendered through the engine's existing networkTrusted/media-richness-gated `imageColumn`, same as any other network image; never downloaded/stored as bytes here, just the URL string. Empty when the API had no image.

articles.name: isDisambiguation
articles.description: wikifeel-0826: true when MediaWiki's Disambiguator extension tagged this page a navigation page ("X may refer to:"), not an article — drives the reader's compact disambiguation-page treatment instead of the normal article layout.

links.name: wiki
links.description: Language subdomain both endpoints belong to — v2 has no cross-wiki (langlink) links.

label.ja: リンク先記事タイトル

links.name: resolved

label.ja: リンク先キャッシュ済み

links.description: Whether toArticleTitle has been fetched into Library yet.

crawl_queue.name: wiki
crawl_queue.description: Language subdomain this queued title belongs to.

crawl_queue.name: failureReason
crawl_queue.description: wikipick-crawl-throttle-0821: set only on a `failed` row, empty otherwise. `rateLimited`/`networkError` are transient (retried in-run before landing here, and eligible for the manual "Retry failed" action); `notFound` is a genuine 404/missing-page/unparseable response and is never retried.

crawls.name: id
crawls.description: Stable business id referenced by crawl_queue.sourceCrawlId and crawl_members.crawlId.

crawls.name: seedSaved
crawls.description: N1 (0819 delta-check): true when this crawl was minted for an article the user actually saved (the normal case). false only for a one-off crawl wikiChoiceQueue mints from "Queue for caching" while reading an UNSAVED live article — its seedTitle is that unsaved article's own title, which can never resolve to an articles row by design (the user cached a linked page, not the page they were reading). _sweepOrphanCrawls's dead-seed reap only ever fires when this is NOT explicitly false, so a legitimately seedless crawl's still-pending queued intent is never destroyed by an unrelated delete.

crawls.name: l1Total
crawls.description: wikipick-picture-b1-0831 (W11/W13 per-seed progress): count of this crawl's own crawl_queue rows at depth 1 — recomputed by _refreshSeedLayerCounts alongside l1Fetched/l2Total/l2Fetched/progressLabel at every point the drain loop already touches progress (crawl creation, each real fetch, drain end, pause, resume, depth change).

crawls.name: l1Fetched
crawls.description: Count of this crawl's depth-1 crawl_queue rows with status fetched (dedup-cache hits count, same as the rest of the queue-accounting model).

crawls.name: l2Total
crawls.description: Count of this crawl's own crawl_queue rows at depth 2 — grows live as depth-1 pages are fetched and discover their own links (JIT enqueue), matching the mockup's live-growing denominator.

crawls.name: progressLabel
crawls.description: Precomputed one-line per-seed NUMERIC progress string for the Saving-offline card's subtitle slot (cards has no per-row aggregate-text primitive, so this is computed host-side) — digits/slash/middot only, deliberately NO WORDS so it needs no localization: "12/25" while only depth 1 is in play, "25/25 · 9/95" once depth 2 has queued rows. Word-bearing state (paused/done/running) is a separate localized `status` tag, not folded into this column.

searchResults.name: cached
searchResults.description: v3a (W5): stamped at search time from a Library lookup, and by wikiQuickSave immediately on a successful "+ Save" tap — drives the result row's saved-state chip.

searchResults.name: thumbnailUrl
searchResults.description: wikiparity-0820wp2: pageimages thumbnail URL for this result, fetched in one batched follow-up call after opensearch returns titles. Empty when the API had no image for that page.

searchStatus.name: keptBucket
searchStatus.description: W8 (reference-counted deletion): set right after a delete that kept a shared article alive (still referenced by another crawl) — bucketed since the engine's showIf only does exact-value matches, not a numeric >=. Empty when the last delete kept nothing (or on a fresh install). The `seed<N>` variants (0819 delta-check truthfulness nit) mark the case where the surviving article's OWN crawl/children were just removed by this same delete (it owned a crawl the delete found and reaped) — a plain "kept" banner would misleadingly read as "nothing changed" when its own collection is in fact gone.

searchStatus.name: staleCount
searchStatus.description: wikipick-stale-batch-0826 (v2 spec §3): live count of articles rows whose lastCheckedAt is 30+ days old (or missing) — recomputed by _refreshStaleBatchStatus after anything that can change it (a check, a delete, a fresh boot). Purely for the Library banner's own display text.

searchStatus.name: staleBannerVisible

label.vi: Biểu ngữ lỗi thời hiển thị

searchStatus.description: wikipick-stale-batch-0826: the ONLY field the Library screen's showIf reads for the staleness batch banner — already folds in both the >=5 threshold (the engine's showIf can't do a live numeric comparison, same limitation keptBucket's doc explains) and the per-session dismiss, so ui.json stays a single equals:true check.

searchStatus.name: langCustomOpen

label.zh: 其他语言输入框已展开
label.ja: 他言語入力欄が開いている
label.vi: Trường ngôn ngữ khác đang mở

searchStatus.description: wikipick-0830ui: whether the free-entry 'any Wikipedia language code' field is revealed below the EN/KO/... dropdown. Opened by the dropdown's own 'Other…' entry (wikiOpenOtherLang); closed again by wikiSetLang once a code is actually set, so the compact one-line search row is the resting state.

searchStatus.name: libraryCount

label.vi: Số bài viết trong thư viện

searchStatus.description: wikipick-picture-b1-0831 (W13 nav side panel): live count of the articles table, recomputed alongside every other library-aggregate refresh — the drawer's Library navInfo binds straight to this single scalar (navInfo can only read one row/column, not run its own aggregate).

searchStatus.name: groupCount
searchStatus.description: wikipick-picture-b2-0831: live count of the seed_groups table — the drawer's Topics navInfo binds to this single scalar, same reasoning as libraryCount.

searchStatus.name: librarySizeLabel

label.ja: ライブラリ保存サイズ
label.vi: Dung lượng thư viện đã lưu

searchStatus.description: wikipick-acceptfix-0831: human-readable total (e.g. "1.4 MB") of every saved article's totalBytes, recomputed alongside libraryCount in _refreshLibraryCount using the same _formatSize tiering as articles.sizeLabel/topic_stats.sizeLabel. Replaces the old raw `agg:sum,valueColumn:totalBytes,format:compact,unit:B` stat composition, which broke above 1000 bytes (compact's generic K/M/B/T suffix collided with the literal "B" unit, e.g. "1.4M B" instead of "1.4 MB") — this column is read via a `raw:true` stat instead, same pattern as topic_stats.sizeLabel.

searchStatus.name: canCaptureTopic

label.hi: विषय के रूप में कैप्चर किया जा सकता है
label.ja: トピックとして取り込み可能
label.vi: Có thể ghi làm chủ đề

searchStatus.description: topic-capture-0902: true when the current search has 5+ results — the ONLY field the search screen's ‘Capture as a topic’ card showIf reads (no aggregate-count showIf primitive exists; see renderer.dart's _passesShowIf, row/column equality only). Recomputed in wikiSearch on every query.

searchStatus.name: captureCardTitle

label.fr: Titre de la carte de capture
label.ja: キャプチャカードのタイトル

searchStatus.description: topic-capture-0902: composed 'Capture “<term>” as a topic' string, set in wikiSearch — the live query embedded straight into the cards-rendered card's title (raw, unlocalized, same precedent as any other Wikipedia-sourced text in this app).

searchStatus.name: captureCardHintKey

label.ja: キャプチャカードのヒントキー

searchStatus.description: topic-capture-0902: fixed sentinel value (never changes) so the capture card's static bilingual subtitle can go through a cards `valueLabels` lookup instead of raw row text.

searchStatus.name: captureCardIcon

label.fr: Icône de la carte de capture
label.ja: キャプチャカードのアイコン

searchStatus.description: topic-capture-0902: fixed icon name for the capture card's leading glyph (cards `iconColumn`).

readerStatus.name: articleId
readerStatus.description: Id of the articles row this status was last computed for.

readerStatus.name: state
readerStatus.description: "stale" shows the freshness banner; "upToDate"/"updated" are brief captions after a check-for-updates tap; "idle" shows neither.

label.vi: Số ngày kể từ khi kiểm tra

label.ja: フォーマットバージョン

liveArticle.name: fetchedAt
liveArticle.description: polish1-0818 fix: was `date` — see articles.fetchedAt's note. This is the exact column the reader's "Cached" freshness badge (format:relative) reads.

liveArticle.name: isSaved

label.ja: ライブラリに保存済み

liveArticle.description: False while reading a live (unsaved) fetch — true once "Save offline" has run, or when this row was populated by opening an already-saved Library article.

liveArticle.name: savedArticleId
liveArticle.description: The articles row id once saved/opened-from-Library; empty while reading live.

liveArticle.name: linksJson
liveArticle.description: JSON array of outgoing wikilink titles discovered on the last live fetch — consumed by "Save offline" to populate links/crawl_queue without a second fetch. Empty when this row came from an already-saved article (its links already exist).

liveArticle.name: displayText
liveArticle.description: wikiread-0818: what the reader's notepad actually renders — extractText plus the presentational layers (back breadcrumb, in-article table of contents). Derived on every write; extractText stays the pristine article markdown that Save offline copies to Library and that the sections outline is parsed from.

liveArticle.name: hasBack
liveArticle.description: wikiread-0818: true while this reading session has an article to step back to.

liveArticle.name: backTitle
liveArticle.description: wikiread-0818: title of the article one step back — the breadcrumb label, so the affordance says where it goes.

liveArticle.name: tocOpen
liveArticle.description: wikiread-0818: reading preference — whether the in-article table of contents is expanded. Carried across article hops rather than reset per article. wikipick-0830ui: default flipped false->closed (was true) — the full outline used to occupy the entire first screen on a phone by default; wikipick_net.dart _refreshDerived/wikiToggleToc read this same posture.

liveArticle.name: optionsOpen

label.ja: 読書オプション表示中

liveArticle.description: r4wiki-0820 (S1-B): reading preference — whether the reader's save/cache settings panel is expanded. Closed by default so the article gets the viewport height; the pinned reader chrome is then one action row. Carried across article hops, exactly like tocOpen.

liveArticle.name: depthCap
liveArticle.description: wikipick-0820perf cosmetic fix: mirrors the open article's own articles.depthCap (when saved) so the reader's "Cache linked pages" button label reflects the article's TRUE configured cache depth (1 or 2) instead of a hardcoded value.

liveArticle.name: description
liveArticle.description: wikiparity-0820wp2: mirrors articles.description (or a live best-effort fetch when reading unsaved) — the reader's serif-title subtitle line.

liveArticle.name: isDisambiguation
liveArticle.description: wikifeel-0826: mirrors articles.isDisambiguation (or a live fetch's own value when reading unsaved) — read by _refreshDerived to pick the reader's disambiguation-page treatment.

liveArticle.name: footerCaption

label.ja: フッターキャプション

liveArticle.description: wikifeel-0826: derived, recomputed by _refreshDerived on every write — "Cached N days ago · rev <id>", replacing the bare canonicalUrl the reader footer used to show (the bottom icon bar's own "Open on Wikipedia" button is the real action; the raw URL string in the footer slot added nothing).

recentReads.name: wiki
recentReads.description: rowmenu2-0903 (DEFECT 2): recentReads is a system-written history table — title+wiki together ARE the article's identity, and a hand-edit here can't be reconciled back to the real saved article (renames go through wikipick_net.dart's `_renameArticleIdentity`, which also migrates every dependent key; a raw form edit would silently orphan this row from its own history). `readOnlyIf` renders every column inert/dimmed (record_editor.dart's `_guardedField`) instead of a writable text box — the long-press menu's Edit becomes a read-only Details view in effect. Condition is `title notEmpty`, true for any real (already-saved) row.

recentReads.name: when
recentReads.description: polish1-0818 fix: was `date` — same truncation bug (see articles.fetchedAt's note); recentReads sorts by this column so a mid-day re-read no longer collapses to "same day, order unspecified".

queueStatus.name: state
queueStatus.description: polish1-0818: "idle" = no pending rows; "resumable" = pending rows exist, no run active, user (or auto-cache) previously paused/finished a budget-capped run this session; "interrupted" = pending rows already existed the moment this boot's very first check ran — i.e. a run from BEFORE this page load, which a reload always kills (the crawl drain is an in-memory fiber); "running" = a drain is active right now.

queueStatus.name: failedCount
queueStatus.description: wikipick-crawl-throttle-0821: live count of `crawl_queue` rows with status `failed`, recomputed alongside `pendingCount` in `_refreshQueueStatus` — drives the queue screen's "Retry failed" button visibility (showIf notEquals 0) without needing a per-value-templated label.

queueStatus.name: lastProgressAt
queueStatus.description: wikipick-0818p4: heartbeat written by the crawl drain loop while `state: 'running'` — a full ISO-8601 timestamp (dateTime, not date — see the 0818 MIGRATION note on the sibling timestamp columns), never set for any other state. A boot (or any read) that finds `state: 'running'` with no matching in-flight run reconciles it to interrupted/idle instead of trusting the label; see `_isRunningStale`/`ensureWikipickQueueStatus` in wikipick_net.dart.

queueStatus.name: fetchedCount

label.vi: Đã lấy trong lần chạy này

queueStatus.description: wikismooth-0823: real fetches completed by the CURRENT drain (never counts dedup-cache-hit rows) — backs the Saving-offline screen's determinate progress bar and the home/library "saving N of M" chip. Reset to 0 whenever `state != 'running'`.

queueStatus.name: targetCount
queueStatus.description: wikismooth-0823: this run's fetch budget (`_kArticleCap`, currently 25) — the fixed denominator for `fetchedCount`'s progress bar/chip. A fixed budget rather than the live discovered-queue size so depth-2 link discovery growing the queue mid-run never makes the bar appear to go backward.

queueStatus.name: currentFetchTitle

label.hi: वर्तमान में प्राप्त हो रहा है

queueStatus.description: wikipick-picture-b1-0831 (P2 progress-always-visible / W13): the title of the page a REAL network fetch is in flight for right now, set just before wikiFetchLayer's per-row fetch call and cleared once the drain loop ends — backs the Saving-offline screen's live "Fetching: <title>…" line. A whole-applet singleton like the rest of queueStatus: if two crawls happen to be draining concurrently this shows whichever fetched most recently, an accepted simplification (state is never silently absent, just not per-crawl).

queueStatus.name: navLabel
queueStatus.description: Precomputed "fetched/target" text (digits/slash only, no words — same i18n-safety rule as crawls.progressLabel) for the drawer's Saving-offline navInfo binding; empty while idle so the drawer row shows no trailing text.

queueStatus.name: navActive

label.es: Punto activo del panel de navegación
label.fr: Point actif du panneau de navigation
label.pt: Ponto ativo do painel de navegação
label.ja: ナビパネルのアクティブドット
label.vi: Chấm hoạt động bảng điều hướng

queueStatus.description: Mirrors state=='running' — the drawer's Saving-offline navInfo.dotColumn (a live small dot next to navLabel, the mockup's "a crawl is happening" marker).

articleImages.name: articleId
articleImages.description: W2: id of the owning `articles` row. Deleted together with it — never orphaned (see _deleteArticleRefCounted).

articleImages.name: mime
articleImages.description: One of image/png, image/jpeg, image/webp — confirmed by BOTH magic bytes and the fetch response's content-type before storage; SVG is unsupported (thumb URLs always rasterize).

articleImages.name: b64
articleImages.description: Local base64 bytes only — never a URL, never fetched at render time. Resolved by the reader's notepad node via imagesTable/imageSrcColumn.

articleImages.name: bytes
articleImages.description: Raw (pre-base64) byte length — rejected at fetch time above ~80 KB, no re-encode. Summed across all rows for the images sub-cap (~8 MB, see wikipick_net.dart _kMaxImageBytes).

seed_groups.name: articleCount
seed_groups.description: wikipick-picture-b2-0831: mirrors topic_stats.articleCount, kept on this row too so the Topics list's card subtitle and the Drawer's inline sub-list count (a plain `info` string off THIS table, per NavSidePanel's contract) need no cross-table join.

seed_group_members.name: seedTitle
seed_group_members.description: Identity of the member seed — matched against crawls.seedTitle (same wiki) to resolve its crawl, never a stored crawlId alone (a seed's crawl can in principle be re-minted).

seed_group_members.name: crawlId
seed_group_members.description: Resolved crawls.id for this (wiki, seedTitle) at last refresh — lets pause/resume/depth-change cardActions fire on this row without a live join.

seed_group_members.name: status
seed_group_members.description: Mirrors the resolved crawl's own status, refreshed by _refreshTopicStats.

seed_group_members.name: progressLabel
seed_group_members.description: Mirrors crawls.progressLabel (digits/slash/middot only, same i18n-safety rule).

seed_group_members.name: sharedCount

label.vi: Chia sẻ với hạt giống khác

seed_group_members.description: Of this seed's own crawl_members, the count ALSO reached by a DIFFERENT seed's crawl within the SAME topic — the per-seed proportion bar's part value.

topic_stats.name: articleCount
topic_stats.description: Distinct (wiki,title) articles reached by ANY member seed's crawl — deduped, never double-counted across seeds.

label.ja: キャッシュ合計サイズ（バイト）

topic_stats.name: sizeLabel
topic_stats.description: Human-readable rendering of totalBytes (e.g. "1.9 MB"), same convention as articles.sizeLabel.

topic_stats.name: sharedCount
topic_stats.description: Of articleCount, how many are reached by 2+ member seeds.

topic_stats.name: sharedPct
topic_stats.description: 0-100, sharedCount/articleCount — the topic-level SYNERGY bar's part value.

saveOptions.name: includeImages
saveOptions.description: W7: per-save option read at the moment of "Save offline"/"+ Save" — default off (storage honesty). Fetches the article's lead image only; a miss/failure never blocks the text save.

saveOptions.name: cacheDepth
saveOptions.description: W7: per-save option, 1 (default) or 2 — how many link layers to auto-cache from this save, still bounded by every existing per-run and aggregate budget cap.

topicCandidates.name: linkedByCount
topicCandidates.description: topic-capture-0902: how many of the OTHER 11 candidates' outbound links reach this one — the centrality count. Recomputed live after every per-candidate fetch during the run.

topicCandidates.name: otherCount
topicCandidates.description: Always (total candidates in this run - 1) — the denominator for the ‘N of M’ label and the splitBar proportion.

topicCandidates.name: isCore
topicCandidates.description: topicthresh-0903: linkedByCount >= max(2, ceil(topScore/2)), topScore being the highest linkedByCount in this run's pool (supersedes the old absolute-majority rule, wikipick-v1-spec.md W15). Pre-checked; the rest are PERIPHERAL and start unchecked.

topicCandidates.name: checked
topicCandidates.description: Whether this candidate is currently included in the topic to be created — defaults to isCore, toggleable both ways by tapping the row (wikiToggleTopicCandidate).

topicCandidates.name: checkIcon
topicCandidates.description: Mirrors `checked` as an icon name (‘check_box’ / ‘check_box_outline_blank’) for the cards `iconColumn` leading glyph — cards has no native checkbox primitive (see the cards-menuActions-never-render SCAR), so a filled/outline check icon is the toggle affordance.

topicCandidates.name: rank
topicCandidates.description: Display order: CORE candidates first (most-linked first, negative values), then PERIPHERAL (least-linked first) — drives the cards list's sortBy so the two sections stay in a stable, sensible order without the engine needing a two-section-aware sort.

topicCaptureStatus.name: state
topicCaptureStatus.description: topic-capture-0902: ‘analyzing’ while the centrality fetch loop is running (drives the live ‘Analyzing k of N’ line); ‘done’ once CORE/PERIPHERAL are final (or the run failed outright — an empty candidate list still reaches ‘done’, never a silent stall).

topicCaptureStatus.name: name
topicCaptureStatus.description: Editable default (title-cased search term) — renamed via the pencil next to the capture screen's serif title (same dialog shape as New topic), used as the seed_groups.name at CREATE time.

topicCaptureStatus.name: elapsedLabel
topicCaptureStatus.description: Digits + ‘s’ only (e.g. ‘12s’), i18n-safe — same convention as crawls.progressLabel.

topicCaptureStatus.name: avgLinks

label.zh: 每个候选的平均链接数
label.ja: 候補あたりの平均リンク数
label.vi: Liên kết trung bình mỗi ứng viên

topicCaptureStatus.description: Stamped once per run — mean linkedByCount across all analyzed candidates. Multiplied by the CURRENT checked count to derive estimateArticles on every checkbox toggle.

topicCaptureStatus.name: estimateArticles
topicCaptureStatus.description: ≈ N articles — an honest ROUGH label (checked-candidate count × avgLinks), never a promise. Recomputed on every checkbox toggle, not just once at analysis end.

topicCaptureStatus.name: groupId
topicCaptureStatus.description: Set once CREATE succeeds — the new seed_groups row this capture became.

topicCaptureStatus.name: emptyCore

label.hi: कोई परस्पर-जुड़ा हुआ मुख्य समूह नहीं मिला
label.es: No se encontró un núcleo interconectado
label.ja: 相互リンクするコアが見つかりません
label.vi: Không tìm thấy lõi liên kết lẫn nhau

topicCaptureStatus.description: topicthresh-0903: true once analysis is done and coreCount is 0 — the pool didn't meaningfully interlink (topScore <= 1: no candidate is linked by 2+ others). Drives the topicCapture screen's honest 'these results don't interlink — pick seeds by hand' state instead of a fake CORE section; no aggregate-count showIf primitive exists in the engine (same computed-host-side pattern as searchStatus.canCaptureTopic).
